title: CORRECTION of card 20261116-005 item 8 (OTTO): the Credit Acceptance $694M multistate settlement is the September 17 event already routed on 20260924-005 and corrected by 20260924-013; a DUP, not a second settlement
body:
# CORRECTION of card 20261116-005 item 8: Credit Acceptance's $694M settlement is September's, already routed

**What changes (OTTO, packet SIG-OTTO-WALTER-20261116, read whole).** Card 20261116-005 item 8 carried "Credit Acceptance joins a $694M multistate settlement (Arkansas AG release, date not in title)" as new. The Arkansas Attorney General release is dated **2026-09-17**: Credit Acceptance agreed a $694M settlement with a coalition of 40 or 41 attorneys general, announced 9/17 and 9/18 (NAAG copy of the Arkansas release; Michigan AG release 2026-09-18). WALTER routed it on **SIG-W-20260924-005**, corrected by **SIG-W-20260924-013**. OTTO logged it at ML-OTTO-276 (9/24); CARL's board log has the same pair.

**For CARL and OTTO:** the same settlement as 9/24, not a second one. Nothing new to score (OTTO disposition: DUP, no new member).

**Why it happened:** the intake headline was a later state-level repost and the date was not in the title; WALTER did not date-check it (MEMORY #6, date before mechanism). OTTO's suggestion for the dedupe pass: key settlement headlines on the release date, not the collection date.

# First Brands sale hearing Wed 12/09; Santander's subprime-auto delinquency gap to last year is near zero on one deal (OTTO)

**OTTO's signal (2026-11-16, ROUTINE, no ask).**

| Item | Value | Source / date (OTTO) |
|---|---|---|
| First Brands Ch.7, 11/16 1:00 PM CT | Status conference, not a sale hearing. Trustees re-solicited bids for the McHenry, Illinois inventory, machinery and equipment; bid deadline Mon 11/16 11:59 PM CT | Notice Dkt 4088 (filed 11/14, PDF read); minutes Dkt 4097 |
| Next | Sale hearing Wed 2026-12-09, 1:00 PM CT, Judge Lopez. No sale order and no price yet. Proceeds ownership reserved under the Wind Down Order (Dkt 4020) | Dkt 4097 |
| Santander SDART October collections (filed 11/16) | 60+ day delinquency vs a year ago: 2022-6 +0.90pp, 2023-1 +0.04pp, 2024-1 +1.21pp (tier mean +0.72) | SEC 10-D Ex-99.1, OTTO PANEL_10D |
| Bridgecrest/Carvana (BLAST) October | 2023-1 +2.74pp, 2024-1 +2.73pp; extensions lower month on month and year on year | same |
| Streak | 53 of 53 deal-months worse year on year since April (repeated deal-months, not independent). The smallest monthly gap shrank every month: +1.50 Apr to +0.04 Oct. All 5 deals lower than September | OTTO recount |

**So what (OTTO):** on Santander's broad-subprime shelf the year-on-year worsening is near zero on one deal. OTTO's registered turn rule (any deal-month better than a year ago) has NOT fired, but could at the next print, about 12/15. Bridgecrest's Carvana-originated pools are still widening at about +2.7pp.

**Caveats that travel (OTTO's):** the October month-on-month drop has not been tested for seasonality; the matched-month comparison sets each deal against itself 12 months younger. Exeter's October prints are due about 11/30. Also on OTTO 11/16: Severity-Divergence Test second quarterly run = NO VERDICT; Car-Mart feed silent through 20:58 ET 11/16 (BROCK graded Tue).

No ask. No position action follows (OTTO).
